roadmap.title: Slums: story and useful habits
roadmap.description: Complete the opening story and work on rescues, crafting and combat counters as you explore.

roadmap.title: Old Town and the campaign finale
roadmap.description: Follow the story through Old Town, Broadcast and the finale. The world remains open for cleanup.

roadmap.title: Collectibles and campaign cleanup
roadmap.description: Finish side quests, collect the 67 text entries and clear safe zones, quarantine zones and Parkour Fever courses.

roadmap.title: Co-op quests and competitions
roadmap.description: Arrange a four-player session for five quests with the same partners. Finish competitions with a partner.

roadmap.title: The Following
roadmap.description: Start The Following and prepare for Bilal’s race early. Restart the challenge before a failed attempt ends. Finish the story and buggy counters.

roadmap.title: Bozak Horde trials
roadmap.description: Clear the stadium trials, earn the bow and arrow blueprints, then win the final co-op survivor fight.

roadmap.title: Hellraid story and raids
roadmap.description: Finish the opening Hellraid story to unlock Raid Mode. Collect notes and prepare equipment before attempting the timed and Nightmare raids.

achievements.description: Perform Rahim’s crane jump during Awakening.
achievements.summary: Perform Rahim’s crane jump during Awakening.

steps.text: During @mechanic{Awakening}, follow Rahim onto the crane and jump into the marked landing area.

achievements.description: Meet Rais during Pact with Rais.
achievements.summary: Meet Rais during Pact with Rais.

steps.text: Visit @npc{Rais} at his garrison during @mechanic{Pact with Rais}.

achievements.description: Escape Rais’s arena during The Pit.
achievements.summary: Escape Rais’s arena during The Pit.

steps.text: Finish the arena fight and escape during @mechanic{The Pit}.

achievements.description: Enter Old Town during The Saviors.
achievements.summary: Enter Old Town during The Saviors.

steps.text: Follow @mechanic{The Saviors} through the sewers and emerge in @loc{Old Town}.

achievements.description: Complete the Public Face story quest.
achievements.summary: Complete the Public Face story quest.

steps.text: Finish @mechanic{Public Face} in Old Town.

achievements.summary: Defeat Tahir during The Museum.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Tahir} in @mechanic{The Museum}.

achievements.description: Reach Camden’s laboratory during The Clinic.
achievements.summary: Reach Camden’s laboratory during The Clinic.

steps.text: Enter @npc{Camden}’s laboratory during @mechanic{The Clinic}.

achievements.summary: Activate the amplifier during Broadcast.

steps.text: Climb the antenna and install the amplifier during @mechanic{Broadcast}.

achievements.description: Finish the main campaign’s Extraction quest.
achievements.summary: Finish the main campaign’s Extraction quest.

steps.text: Complete @mechanic{Extraction} and the final encounter with @enemy{Rais}.

achievements.summary: Finish the 44 base-campaign side quests listed in Extras > Statistics.

guide.context: Side quests remain available after the campaign ends.

steps.text: Complete the side quests listed under @mechanic{Extras > Statistics}. Use the remaining names there to find unfinished quests in the Slums and Old Town.

achievements.summary: Collect 15 Disaster Relief On-site Packages.

steps.text: Loot airdrops or collect the five packages inside @loc{Stuffed Turtle}. Re-enter the quarantine zone to collect more until you have taken 15.

achievements.summary: Rescue 15 survivors from attacking zombies.

steps.text: Check blue encounter markers in the @loc{Slums}. Kill the zombies attacking a survivor and finish 15 rescues.

achievements.summary: Rescue 15 survivors held by Rais’s men or bandits.

guide.context: Bandit attacks at Countryside altars also count if you own The Following.

steps.text: Visit blue encounter markers and kill the bandits holding survivors. Complete 15 rescues.

achievements.summary: Kill five Bolters.

steps.text: After the story introduces @enemy{Bolters}, visit a marked feeding ground at night and kill the Bolter before it flees. Sleep at a nearby safe zone to refresh the encounter until you have five kills.

achievements.displayName: I'm a Runner and a fighter
achievements.summary: Finish 15 Agility or Power challenges.

guide.context: Parkour Fever courses belong to a separate set of challenges.

steps.text: Complete 15 rounds of the Agility or Power challenges marked around the Slums and Old Town.

achievements.summary: Win seven co-op competitions.

steps.text: While playing with a partner, accept competition invitations together and win seven events.

achievements.summary: Finish ten co-op competitions.

steps.text: Accept and finish ten competition events with a co-op partner.

achievements.summary: Earn a total of $10,000 by selling items.

steps.text: Sell valuables and spare equipment to merchants until your combined sales reach @item{$10,000}.

achievements.summary: Clear the eight original Quarantine Zones.

guide.context: Holy Year Tunnel and Three Moons Restaurant are outside the required set.

collectibles.name: Stuffed Turtle
collectibles.location: Northern grocery store
collectibles.method: Collect the five Disaster Relief packages.

collectibles.name: Sunny Apartments
collectibles.location: Apartment building in the northwest
collectibles.method: Kill all 23 Infected inside; bring Medkits for the smoke.

collectibles.name: Chemical Storage
collectibles.location: Southwestern storage building
collectibles.method: Enter through the taped sliding door and recover five packages.

collectibles.name: Bright Mountain Tunnel
collectibles.location: Southern railway tunnel
collectibles.method: Recover five packages; bring strong weapons for the Virals.

collectibles.name: Underground Parking
collectibles.location: Northern underground car park
collectibles.method: Recover five packages while avoiding or killing the Volatiles.

collectibles.name: Striped Dragon Hotel
collectibles.location: Northern hotel
collectibles.method: Recover the five packages inside.

collectibles.name: Parking Lot
collectibles.location: Underground car park west of Thabit’s building
collectibles.method: Kill all 45 enemies inside.

collectibles.name: New Antalya Apartments
collectibles.location: Apartment block in the south
collectibles.method: Recover the four packages inside.

achievements.summary: Manually secure the 17 optional safe zones across the Slums and Old Town.

guide.context: The required set contains 12 safe zones in the Slums and five in Old Town; automatic story unlocks do not replace them.

steps.text: Visit the red house icons in the Slums and Old Town. Remove the Infected, close any open gates and restore power wherever the zone requires it.

achievements.description: Run (move or sprint) at least 42,195 m
achievements.summary: Travel 42,195 metres on foot.

steps.text: Walk or sprint between objectives until your total distance reaches @mechanic{42,195 metres}.

achievements.description: Climb at least 8848 meters on various objects.
achievements.summary: Accumulate 8,848 metres of climbing.

steps.text: Climb buildings and other objects throughout the campaign until your total ascent reaches @mechanic{8,848 metres}.

achievements.summary: Defeat one Infected.

steps.text: Kill the Infected on floor 13 during @mechanic{Awakening}.

achievements.summary: Electrocute five zombies at the same time.

steps.text: Find a water pool with an electrical trap. Throw @item{Firecrackers} into the water to gather at least five zombies, then activate the trap.

achievements.description: Kill 20 enemies in a row without taking damage.
achievements.summary: Defeat 20 consecutive enemies without suffering damage.

steps.text: Stay on a roof, group zombies below with @item{Firecrackers}, and kill them with @item{Molotovs}. Reach 20 kills without being hit; restart the streak if you take damage.

achievements.description: Kill 100 enemies by kicking them off the rooftops/cliffs.
achievements.summary: Kill 100 enemies with kicks that send them off roofs or cliffs.

steps.text: Kick enemies off high roofs in @loc{Old Town}. Use drops high enough to kill them and accumulate 100 fatal falls.

achievements.summary: Defeat one Volatile.

steps.text: At night, shoot a @enemy{Volatile} near a safe zone until it dies, then retreat behind the UV lights.

achievements.summary: Silence one Screamer.

steps.text: In Old Town, approach a @enemy{Screamer} and use the on-screen prompt to silence the Screamer.

achievements.description: Stick a burning zombie on spikes
achievements.summary: Impale a zombie on spikes while the zombie is burning.

steps.text: Find a zombie beside a spike trap. Ignite the zombie with a @item{Molotov}, then kick the burning zombie onto the spikes.

achievements.summary: Defeat 50 enemies with thrown weapons.

steps.text: Craft or buy throwing stars and knives, then use them to deliver 50 killing blows.

achievements.summary: Defeat 50 enemies with ranged shooting weapons.

steps.text: Use a firearm, bow or crossbow to kill 50 enemies.

achievements.description: Catch 25 enemies in the Electric Fence trap
achievements.summary: Trap 25 enemies with Electric Fences.

steps.text: Learn @mechanic{Electric Fences} in the Survivor skill tree. Find an electric fence trap, lure zombies against it with Firecrackers, and activate the trap. Accumulate 25 trapped enemies.

achievements.description: Blind 25 Volatiles with flares or a flashlight
achievements.summary: Blind 25 Volatiles with UV light or flares.

steps.text: At night, aim the @item{UV Flashlight} at Volatiles or throw flares beside them until they recoil. Blind 25 different Volatiles.

achievements.description: Kill 25 enemies using Ground Pound or Drop Attack
achievements.summary: Defeat 25 enemies with Ground Pound or Drop Attack.

steps.text: Unlock @mechanic{Ground Pound} or @mechanic{Drop Attack} in the Power tree, then use either skill to kill 25 enemies.

achievements.summary: Use Grapple to throw enemies 50 times.

steps.text: Learn @mechanic{Grapple} in the Agility tree. Use the skill against attacking enemies until you have made 50 throws.

achievements.description: Survive night pursuit of level two or higher
achievements.summary: Escape a night pursuit after reaching pursuit level two or higher.

steps.text: Let Volatiles spot you at night and keep the chase going until the pursuit reaches level two. Escape into a safe zone or hide until the pursuit ends.

achievements.description: Blind 25 enemies in the Light Trap
achievements.summary: Blind 25 enemies with Light Traps.

steps.text: At night, lure Volatiles or Virals to the Light Traps on the road beside @loc{Dr. Zere’s laboratory}. Activate a trap when enemies are close. Alternate between the traps as they recharge until you have blinded 25 enemies.

achievements.summary: Make one item through crafting.

steps.text: Collect the Alcohol and Gauze, then craft the tutorial @item{Medkit}.

achievements.summary: Craft items from blueprints 100 times.

steps.text: Use blueprints to make Medkits, Firecrackers and other supplies until you have completed 100 crafting actions.

achievements.summary: Pick ten locks successfully.

steps.text: Craft @item{Lockpicks} from Metal Parts and open ten locked containers or doors.

achievements.summary: Raise Survivor Rank to level 12.

steps.text: Complete quests and turn Disaster Relief packages in to a @npc{Quartermaster} until Survivor Rank reaches 12.

achievements.summary: Raise Survivor Rank to level 18.

steps.text: Keep completing quests and handing Disaster Relief packages to a @npc{Quartermaster} until Survivor Rank reaches 18.

achievements.summary: Raise Agility proficiency to level 10.

steps.text: Earn Agility experience by running, jumping and climbing until Agility reaches level 10.

achievements.summary: Raise Power proficiency to level 10.

steps.text: Fight Infected to earn enough Power experience for level 10.

achievements.description: Complete 1 quest in a co-op game
achievements.summary: Finish one quest while playing co-op.

steps.text: Finish a quest with at least one partner. A complete @loc{Stuffed Turtle} quarantine run also counts.

achievements.description: Complete 5 quests in a single co-op game with the same 3 partners
achievements.summary: Finish five quests in one co-op session with the same three partners.

steps.text: Form a four-player group and clear @loc{Stuffed Turtle} five times without changing partners or leaving the session.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy with a wrench, using Vault followed by Drop Attack
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy with a wrench Drop Attack immediately after Vault.

steps.text: Unlock @mechanic{Vault} and @mechanic{Drop Attack}, then equip a wrench. Vault over a zombie and immediately use Drop Attack to kill the zombie with the wrench.

achievements.description: Add a fire elemental effect to a sword or a khopesh
achievements.summary: Apply a fire effect to a sword or khopesh.

steps.text: Select a sword or khopesh and apply a compatible fire blueprint, such as @item{Standard-Issue Hellfire}.

achievements.description: Jump to the water from the Infamy Bridge (Slums) at night
achievements.summary: Jump from Infamy Bridge into the water at night.

steps.text: Go to @loc{Infamy Bridge} in the Slums at night. Jump from the broken end of the roadway into the water below.

achievements.summary: Finish all ten Parkour Fever courses.

guide.context: Ultimate Runner removes sprint stamina limits. Keep the momentum combo active for faster movement; using the grappling hook fails a run. If all ten courses are complete but the achievement stays locked, restart the game and finish a course again.

achievements.description: Open 5 GRE chests in Quarantine Zones

achievements.summary: Complete all 20 Bozak Horde trials.

guide.context: The stadium temporarily removes your normal equipment. If the final trial is complete but the achievement stays locked, exit and restart the game.

steps.text: Use the @loc{Bozak Horde} poster in the Tower to enter the stadium. Complete all 20 trials before your shared three lives run out.

achievements.summary: Win the final survivor fight in a co-op Bozak Horde run.

guide.context: If the win does not unlock the achievement, run the trials again and swap the host.

steps.text: Complete the 20 Bozak trials with at least one co-op partner. In the final fight between players, kill the other players and be the sole survivor.

achievements.description: Learn how to craft Electric Arrows
achievements.summary: Unlock the Electric Arrow blueprint.

steps.text: Finish the Bozak Horde once to earn @item{Bozak’s Bow}. Enter another run, loot arrows from Virals and kill ten Virals with the bow.

achievements.description: Learn how to craft Exploding Arrows
achievements.summary: Finish a Bozak Horde run with the Exploding Arrow blueprint unlocked.

guide.context: If the blueprint unlocks without the achievement, complete another run within the same time limit.

steps.text: Finish the Bozak Horde once to activate the arrow-blueprint challenges.

On a later run, clear Trial 20 within the total limit: 31 minutes solo, 28 with two players, 26 with three, or 25 with four. Kill the final Virals and Demolishers to finish the trial and receive the blueprint and achievement.

achievements.description: Score 10 headshots on Rais's men with a bow
achievements.summary: Land ten bow headshots on Rais’s men.

steps.text: Buy a bow from a merchant after reaching Survivor Rank 9. Shoot Rais’s men in the head ten times.

achievements.summary: Reach the Countryside at the start of The Following.

steps.text: Start @mechanic{The Following} and follow @mechanic{The Way Out} to the cliff overlooking the Countryside.

achievements.displayName: And you liked him, didn't you?
achievements.summary: Reach the lighthouse reunion during At the End of the Tunnel.

steps.text: Climb to the top of the lighthouse during @mechanic{At the End of the Tunnel}.

achievements.displayName: I was waiting for you for so long
achievements.summary: Reach Disciple standing with the Children of the Sun.

steps.text: Complete Countryside quests and encounters to raise your trust with the @npc{Children of the Sun} to @mechanic{Disciple}.

achievements.description: Kill a Demolisher with a car.
achievements.summary: Kill a Demolisher with the buggy.

steps.text: Find a @enemy{Demolisher} in the Countryside and weaken the Demolisher with weapons. Finish the kill by ramming the Demolisher with your buggy.

achievements.displayName: It wasn't that hard, was it?
achievements.summary: Win the initial Burning Rubber race without recording a failed attempt.

guide.context: Failing the initial race can lose the achievement for this playthrough.

steps.text: Read the racing poster at @npc{Bilal}’s gas station and speak to Bilal to start @mechanic{Burning Rubber}. Repair your buggy before attempting the race.
Pass all 23 checkpoints within @mechanic{3 minutes 20 seconds}. If you are about to fail, pause and choose @mechanic{Restart Challenge} before time expires.

achievements.displayName: What if you picked the other one?
achievements.summary: Complete either main ending of The Following.

steps.text: Finish the final conversation with @npc{the Mother} and complete either ending.

achievements.summary: Attend the Children of the Sun gathering.

steps.text: Raise your trust to @mechanic{Ally} through Countryside quests. Answer the Acolyte’s invitation and attend the meeting at @loc{Eye of the Sun}.

achievements.displayName: You realize it's only points, don't you?
achievements.summary: Raise Driver Rank to level 12.

steps.text: Drive off-road, take jumps, run over zombies and finish driving challenges until @mechanic{Driver Rank} reaches 12.

achievements.summary: Destroy 50 scarecrows in the Countryside.

steps.text: Drive your buggy through scarecrows in the Countryside fields. Revisit the fields as scarecrows respawn until you have destroyed 50.

achievements.displayName: I don't approve of mindless fun
achievements.summary: Kill 500 zombies with the buggy.

steps.text: Drive through groups of zombies in the Countryside until your buggy has killed 500.

achievements.description: Lose three lives before taking the first Clavis fragment in Hellraid.
achievements.summary: Exhaust three lives on the first floor of Hellraid’s Raid Mode before taking the first Clavis fragment.

steps.text: Enter @mechanic{Raid Mode} in Hellraid and jump off the starting tower until all three lives are gone. Do this before collecting the first @item{Clavis fragment}.

achievements.summary: Kill 50 Hellraid skeletons through fall damage.

steps.text: In Hellraid, lure skeletons onto high ledges and kick or Grapple them over the edge. Accumulate 50 kills from the fall itself.

achievements.description: Finish Hellraid with only one life left and 0 medkits
achievements.summary: Finish a Hellraid raid with exactly one life and no healing potions remaining.

steps.text: Play a Hellraid raid on Normal. Before killing the Minotaur, spend lives until only one remains.
Defeat the Minotaur and clear the remaining enemies. Before entering the exit portal, use up every Health Potion; damage yourself with a flask if you need to heal again.

achievements.summary: Raise Hellraid Rank to level 10.

steps.text: Kill enemies and complete Hellraid quests, bounties and raids until @mechanic{Hellraid Rank} reaches 10.

achievements.displayName: Clavis was a key all along
achievements.summary: Insert the three Clavis fragments into Hellraid’s arena.

guide.context: After the campaign prologue, use the Hellraid arcade beside the Tower merchants to start Hellraid’s opening story.

steps.text: During @mechanic{Clavis Stones}, collect the three fragments and place them in the centre of the arena.

achievements.displayName: Time to file a tax form
achievements.description: Earn more than 3000 coins in one run
achievements.summary: Earn over 3,000 Hellraid coins during one raid.

steps.text: Loot enemies, containers and the final vault during one Hellraid raid. Dismantle unwanted weapons for more coins and earn at least @item{3,001 coins} before finishing.

achievements.summary: Complete a Hellraid raid on Nightmare difficulty.

steps.text: On Normal, gather strong Hellraid weapons, Health Potions, flasks and Rusty Shivs. Track a base-game quest, quit to the menu, then choose @mechanic{Play > Play Campaign > Advanced Options > Play & Switch to Nightmare}.
Return to the Hellraid arcade and finish a raid. Break the mages’ line of sight, separate fast enemies from groups and use flasks or shivs against dangerous enemies and the Minotaur.

achievements.summary: Collect the ten original Hellraid notes.

guide.context: Complete Hellraid’s opening story to unlock Raid Mode. Collect these notes there; the three Lord Hector notes do not count.

collectibles.name: The Count’s Blood-Covered Letter
collectibles.location: Starting tower, Count Begeor statue
collectibles.method: Check the left side of the statue’s base.

collectibles.name: Vara’s Request
collectibles.location: Dining hall, upper room at the far end
collectibles.method: Take the note from the cabinet beside the chest before using the main lever.

collectibles.name: Mysterious Book
collectibles.location: Kitchen adjoining the dining hall
collectibles.method: Use the red book on the bottom shelf at the back. Enter the secret room and take the note beside the weapon rack.

collectibles.name: Library Notes
collectibles.location: Library reading room to the left of the entrance
collectibles.method: Check the floor between two bookcases beside the table.

collectibles.name: The Last Report
collectibles.location: Library upper floor, room across the exterior beam
collectibles.method: Leave through the window and cross the beam. Take the note beside the skeleton in the left corner.

collectibles.group: Between the first and second fragments
collectibles.name: Anat’s Instructions
collectibles.location: Torture area after the first fragment
collectibles.method: From the lower floor’s left side, enter the corridor near the stairs. Follow the corridor to the left-hand interrogation room and search the table.

collectibles.group: Between the first and second fragments
collectibles.name: The Appearance of the Chosen One
collectibles.location: Blood-pool chamber after the second prison room
collectibles.method: Go downstairs to the leftmost corner. Look behind the large book standing on a podium.

collectibles.name: The Fate of the Chosen One – Part One
collectibles.location: Room containing a broken statue
collectibles.method: Go behind the statue and search the sarcophagus.

collectibles.name: Anat’s Letter
collectibles.location: Lava room, upper exit doors
collectibles.method: Check the chair to the left of the doors.

collectibles.name: The Fate of the Chosen One – Part Two
collectibles.location: Third-fragment chamber at the bottom of the tower
collectibles.method: Before taking the fragment, check the chair along the wall left of the pedestal.

achievements.summary: Complete a Hellraid raid in less than 30 minutes.

steps.text: Use Normal difficulty and bring your best Hellraid equipment. Follow the raid objectives, skip optional rooms and finish the raid before @mechanic{30 minutes}.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy by knocking the enemy into Hellraid’s lava.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy by knocking the enemy into Hellraid’s lava.

guide.context: After the campaign prologue, start Hellraid through the arcade beside the Tower merchants.

steps.text: After the second @item{Clavis fragment}, enter the lava room and kick an enemy off the low bridge into lava. Choose a short drop so the lava delivers the kill.
